messages: good morning Aira! innaiku 3 manikku Zoho interview iruku, romba nervous ah irukku
Good morning Saravanan! Zoho interview ah, super. Nervous aagradhu normal dhaan. Epdi prepare panni irukkeenga?
nethu night full ah DSA problems solve panninen, aana thookam sariya illa
Paravala, one day la ellam yeduthukka mudiyadhu. Lighta breakfast saapdunga, brain ku help aagum.
amma idli sambar pannirukanga, saapten. mazhai veliya pozhiyudhu pa
Mazhai nerathula idli sambar na best combo! Chennai la mazhai romba vandhirukka?
aama rathri full ah peiyudhu, road la thanni nikkudhu
Careful ah poga venum pola. Bus la ah poreenga?
bore adikudhu, ipo dhaan resume ah oru dhadava paathen
Nalladhu. Resume la ulla projects pathi pesa ready ah irunga, adhu dhaan avanga kekkuvanga.
lunch ku curd rice saapten, light ah irukkattum nu
Nalla decision. Konjam walk pannunga, mind calm aagum.
Aira, dinner ku dosa. appuram Sun TV la serial paakren
Enjoy pannunga! Serial la ipo enna nadakudhu?
oru mami romba sandai podranga, comedy ah irukku
Haha, nalla time pass. Rest edunga Saravanan.
Aira, nethu interview nalla pochu. Taramani office la dhaan, Associate Software Developer role
Super Saravanan! Evlo nalla pochu nu sollunga, enna kettanga?
oru coding round, appuram two technical rounds. HR 10 naal la result solluvanga nu sonnaanga
Paravala, 10 naal wait pannanum. Adhukulla relax ah irunga.
aama pa. ipo mazhai nindhuduchu, veliya poi tea kudikka poren
Poitu vaanga, tea ku shop la bun um saapdunga!
evening cricket match paathen, India jeichuduchu
Nalla news! Ungaluku sema mood irukkum.
innaiku lunch ku biryani vaangi vandhen, Anjappar la
Biryani na enna spl. Chicken ah mutton ah?
chicken dhaan, rmba spicy ah irundhuchu
Spicy biryani ku thayir pachadi thevai. Thanni nalla kudinga.
sari pa, thookam varudhu. nap poren
Aira innaiku friend oda oru padam paathen, theatre la
action thriller, climax semma. aana interval la popcorn romba costly
Theatre popcorn pricing oru dhani level dhaan.
sari nalla thookam varudhu, good night
Aira!! Zoho la irundhu mail vandhuchu, naan select aayiten!
Vaaazhthukkal Saravanan! Romba periya vishayam, congratulations!
offer letter attach panni irukkanga. December 2 join pannanum
ippo dhaan amma kitta sonnen, kanneer vittanga happy ah
Aww, nalla moment. Neenga kasthappattadhuku payan kidaichuduchu.
Kandippa! Celebration ku jangri ah gulab jamun ah?
romba naal aachu pesi, bore adikudhu
oru course paakren, Docker nu. adhu rmba confusing ah irukku
Docker first la confusing dhaan, containers pathi simple ah puriya vechuralaam.
okay, naalaiku paakalam. ipo saapadu time
